title: The Prom of the band room
author: H. M. Vane
blurb: Vesper Ashgrove, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
